goal: Pinned 3D morphing scroll parallax slideshow for vital organs section
audience: Prospective organ donors and clinical registry participants
references: Apple product scroll storytelling (pinned scrub architecture)
antiSlop: No generic purple AI lighting or blurry canvas resizing
No inescapable scrolljacking or jerky frame drops
Preserve WCAG light and dark mode contrast fidelity
duration: Dynamic scroll scrub (pinned section ~350vh total travel)
aspect: Responsive desktop 16:9 to mobile vertical viewport adaptation
tech: GSAP 3.12 + ScrollTrigger + CSS 3D perspective transforms + Vanilla JS
successMetric: Silky 60fps scrub where 3D organs morph and rotate along z-axis with clinical lives-saved HUDs and clean release to signup form
interactionThesis: As user scrolls into the Organ Matrix, page locks into a cinematic 3D specimen stage. Scrolling forward scrubs the timeline: the active 3D organ rotates, zooms, and recedes into deep space while the next organ materializes from z-depth with golden vascular illumination and clinical telemetry. Damped spring physics give each transition physical weight and clinical precision before unlocking into the signup form.
